source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    keep = {color for color, count in counts.items() if color != background and count >= 6}
    return [[value if value == background or value in keep else background for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
path=progdir/'task-33b0b16b.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.read_text())
